get.summary: Retrieves the list of profile folders available in the specified workspace.
get.description: This method retrieves a list of folders available in the specified workspace. Optionally, it is possible to limit the number of results, specify filters, or define sorting conditions. If no parameters are specified, the method returns the first page of profile folders in the default order.

parameters.name: workspaceId
parameters.description: Workspace identifier. -1 means the default workspace.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Zero based start index for pagination.

parameters.name: total
parameters.description: Maximum number of folders to retrieve, page size.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique folder identifier (optional filter).

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Folder name (optional filter).

parameters.name: sorting
parameters.description: Sorting condition: Id, Name, FolderType, Quantity (optional). Sorting string format: "propertyName ASC" for ascending order or "propertyName DESC" for descending order. For example, "name ASC" or "createdAt DESC".

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: Folder location: "Local" or "Cloud". Defaults to null. When null is specified, folders of all locations will be returned.

post.summary: Creates a new profile folder in the specified workspace.
post.description: This method creates a profile folder. The caller must ensure that the specified workspace ID and location are valid. Profile folders are contained within workspaces and can be used to organize browser profiles. Each folder has a unique identifier, a name, a location (Local or Cloud), and a quantity representing the number of profiles it contains. Profile folders count is limited by tariff.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of the profile folder. Cannot be null or empty.

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: Folder location: "Local" or "Cloud". Defaults to "Local".

parameters.name: workspaceId
parameters.description: Workspace identifier. -1 means the default workspace.

put.summary: Updates the name of the specified profile folder.
put.description: This method can be used to update the profile folder name.

parameters.name: profileFolderId
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the profile folder to update.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The new name for the profile folder.

parameters.name: workspaceId
parameters.description: Workspace identifier. -1 means the default workspace.

delete.description: This method is used for deleting a profile folder. The profileFolderId value must match the existing folder in the specified workspace.

parameters.name: profileFolderId
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the profile folder to delete.

parameters.name: workspaceId
parameters.description: Workspace identifier. -1 means the default workspace.

get.summary: Retrieves accessible browser profiles with optional filters and sorting.
get.description: This method retrieves a list of profiles with their attributes from the specified workspace and the folder. It is possible to optionally filter results by ID, name, tags, and sorting.

parameters.name: workspaceId
parameters.description: Workspace identifier. -1 means the default workspace.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Zero based start index for pagination.

parameters.name: total
parameters.description: Maximum number of profiles to retrieve, page size.

parameters.name: folderId
parameters.description: Optional folder ID for filtering profiles. Pass null to ignore this filter.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Optional profile ID to filter. Pass null to ignore this filter.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Optional name for filtering profiles. Pass empty string to ignore this filter.

parameters.name: sorting
parameters.description: Optional sorting string to determine the order of the returned profiles. Pass an empty string for default sorting. Sorting string format: "propertyName ASC" for ascending order or "propertyName DESC" for descending order. For example, "name ASC" or "createdAt DESC".

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: Optional list of tags to filter profiles by. Example: '"tag 1" "ta g2"'.

parameters.name: tagOperator
parameters.description: Tag filter operator: Or returns profiles with any of the tags, And returns profiles with all tags. Default value is And.

post.summary: Creates a new browser profile in the specified workspace and folder.
post.description: This method creates a new browser profile in the specified workspace and the folder. It is possible to customize various parameters such as screen size, hardware emulation, language, timezone, proxy, and others. All parameters are optional if another is not specified. Browser profile is a set of parameters for browser configuration that can be used to create browser instances with different fingerprints and settings. Each profile has a unique identifier that is returned upon creation and can be used for subsequent operations on the profile, such as updating or deleting.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The profile name.

parameters.name: workspaceId
parameters.description: Workspace identifier. -1 means the default workspace.

parameters.name: folderId
parameters.description: Folder identifier (optional).

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: Profile tags separated by spaces (optional).

parameters.name: notes
parameters.description: Additional notes for the profile.

parameters.name: proxyServerId
parameters.description: Proxy server identifier (optional).

parameters.name: presetId
parameters.description: Optional preset identifier used to initialize the profile configuration.

parameters.name: screen
parameters.description: Screen configuration settings. Allowed values: "auto" to use value from fingerprint, "ignore" to use system value, or one of the named resolution IDs: "SVGA" (800×600), "WSVGA" (1024×600), "XGA" (1024×768), "HD" (1280×720), "WXGA" (1280×768), "WXGA+" (1280×800), "SXGA" (1280×1024), "WXGA HD" (1366×768), "WSXGA" (1440×900), "HD+" (1600×900), "UXGA" (1600×1200), "WSXGA+" (1680×1050), "FHD" (1920×1080), "WUXGA" (1920×1200), "WQHD" (2560×1440), "4K UHD-1" (3840×2160), "5K" (5120×2880), "8K UHD-2" (7680×4320), and others such as "XGA+", "SXGA-", "SXGA+", "1360×768", "1536×864", "QWXGA", "QXGA", "WQXGA". Use the exact named ID string, not pixel dimensions directly.

parameters.name: cpu
parameters.description: CPU configuration settings. Allowed values: "auto" to use value from fingerprint, "ignore" to use system value, or one of the specific core/thread strings: "2/4", "4/8", "6/12", "8/16", "10/20", "12/24", "14/28", "16/32", "32/64", "64/128". Use the exact string including the slash, e.g. "4/8" not "4".

parameters.name: memory
parameters.description: Memory configuration settings. Allowed values: "auto" to use value from fingerprint, "ignore" to use system value, or one of the specific GB values as a string: "2", "4", "8", "16", "32", "64", "128".

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Browser language settings. Allowed values: "auto" to use value from fingerprint, "ignore" to use system value, or one of the supported locale codes: "ru" (Russian), "en-US" (English US), "de" (German), "fr" (French), "es" (Spanish), "en-GB" (English UK).

parameters.name: geoLocation
parameters.description: Geographic location settings. Allowed values: "auto" to use value from fingerprint, or from one to seven comma-separated numbers for coordinates (Latitude, Longitude, Altitude, Accuracy, AltitudeAccuracy, Heading, Speed, Radius). Numbers can be skipped (e.g., "10, , 40, , 60, 70"). Note: "ignore" is not supported for this field and will cause an error.

parameters.name: timeZone
parameters.description: Time zone settings. Allowed values: "auto" to use value from fingerprint, "ignore" to use system value, or custom timezone value (e.g., Europe/Moscow).

parameters.name: webGl
parameters.description: WebGL configuration settings. Allowed values: "auto" to use value from fingerprint, "ignore" to use system value.

parameters.name: webGpu
parameters.description: WebGPU configuration settings. Allowed values: "on" to enable or "off" to disable.

parameters.name: webRtc
parameters.description: WebRTC configuration settings. Allowed values: "Emulate" to use value from fingerprint, "Real" to use system value, or "Hide" to disable.

parameters.name: domRect
parameters.description: DOM Rectangle configuration settings. Allowed values: "Ignore" to disable or "Noise" to use dom rect noising.

parameters.name: audio
parameters.description: Audio configuration settings. Allowed values: "on" to enable or "off" to disable.

parameters.name: fonts
parameters.description: Font configuration settings. Allowed values: "on" to enable or "off" to disable.

parameters.name: battery
parameters.description: Battery configuration settings. Allowed values: "on" to enable or "off" to disable.

parameters.name: plugins
parameters.description: Browser plugins configuration. Allowed values: "on" to enable or "off" to disable.

parameters.name: speechVoices
parameters.description: Speech voices configuration. Allowed values: "on" to enable or "off" to disable.

parameters.name: canvas
parameters.description: Canvas settings. The allowed values are: "Ignore" to disable this feature or "Noise" to use noising.

parameters.name: mediaDevices
parameters.description: Media devices settings. The allowed values are: "auto" to use value from fingerprint, "ignore" to use real values or custom location values. You can specify from one to three integer numbers that represent the following values: AudioInput, AudioOutput and VideoInput. The numbers can be skipped. For example, the following values are valid: 1,,5 - means AudioInput = 1, AudioOutput = random, VideoInput = 5

parameters.name: commandLineArguments
parameters.description: Custom command line arguments to pass to the browser on startup
